sees: frame 1: A cartoon man with glasses and dark hair with two horn-like tufts stands in a room (window, shelf with cups), holding a small dark smartphone in his raised hand near his chest; a bag hangs at his side.
frame 2: The same man stands in a blurred plain room; the phone now sits on a small wooden stool next to him, and his hands are not holding it.
frame 3: The man stands with one arm stretched out to the side toward a large phone icon with a chat bubble (three dots) floating in the air; the phone is out of his hands.
actor: A man with glasses, dark hair with two horn-like tufts, blue-grey sweater and a shoulder bag
object: A smartphone (finally shown as a large phone icon with a message bubble)
before: In frame 1 the man holds the phone in his hand close to his body
after: In frame 3 the phone is away from him, floating as a big icon at arm's length, his arm pointing or pushing it away
change: The phone moves from his hand, to a stool beside him, to being held out or pushed away from him at a distance
consequence: Putting the phone away from yourself, out of reach, frees your attention from messages and notifications; distance from the phone reduces its pull
message: The narrator is saying that keeping your phone out of your hands and at a distance helps you stop it stealing your focus.
